title: 美术风格不讨喜且视觉设计缺乏吸引力
description: 游戏的美术风格、角色设计、飞船设计等视觉表现被玩家认为丑陋、粗糙、不协调或需要时间适应，整体缺乏视觉吸引力。
evidence: sprites are not too my taste
the graphics are an acquired taste

evidence_items.quote: I think there could be much better 3D modeling for characters and held props
evidence_items.description: 角色和手持道具的3D建模质量差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我觉得角色和手持道具的3D建模本可以好得多

evidence_items.quote: The ships are so poorly designed that they don't look like spaceships at all; they look like a turd in the toilet after a heavy night of partying.
evidence_items.description: 飞船设计糟糕，不像宇宙飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这些飞船设计得如此糟糕，根本不像宇宙飞船；它们看起来就像狂欢一夜后马桶里的一坨屎。

evidence_items.quote: sprites are not too my taste
evidence_items.quote_zh: 像素图不太合我的口味

evidence_items.quote: Graphics is ugly. Ugly faces, ugly items, ugly pixel-"art"
evidence_items.description: 画面丑陋，包括人脸、物品和像素美术
evidence_items.quote_zh: 画面很丑。丑陋的脸、丑陋的物品、丑陋的像素“艺术”

evidence_items.quote: the graphics are an acquired taste
evidence_items.description: 画面风格需要时间适应
evidence_items.quote_zh: 画面是需要慢慢培养才能欣赏的

evidence_items.quote: how ugly all the characters are is annoying as hell, pretty hard to even customize a good looking character
evidence_items.description: 角色头像普遍难看，难以定制出好看的角色
evidence_items.quote_zh: 所有角色都丑得要命，这烦人极了，甚至很难自定义出一个好看的角色

evidence_items.quote: the movement, inventory, and even the graphics are too rough and clunky for me
evidence_items.quote_zh: 移动、物品栏，甚至画面对我来说都太粗糙、太笨重了

evidence_items.quote: The game is doesn’t have the best graphics
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏的画面并不是最好的

evidence_items.quote: it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body
evidence_items.description: 女性角色只是在默认男性身体上换脸，看起来滑稽
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它只是换了一张不同的脸而已，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽

evidence_items.quote: All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers.
evidence_items.description: 母亲角色看起来像男性，父亲也奇怪，父母外观异常
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我遇到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次都是这样，那些长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。

evidence_items.quote: the overall art direction as just generally very ugly and unappealing in any way
evidence_items.description: 整体美术方向丑陋且不吸引人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 整体艺术风格就是普遍非常丑陋，而且在任何方面都毫无吸引力

evidence_items.quote: genel atmosfer, arayüz ve oyunun genel görselliği inanılmaz itici. Sanki bir mobil oyunu emulator ile oynuyormuşum gibi hissettim
evidence_items.description: 整体氛围、界面和视觉呈现非常令人反感，像用模拟器玩手游
evidence_items.quote_zh: 整体氛围、界面和游戏的整体视觉效果都令人难以置信地倒胃口。我感觉自己像是在用模拟器玩一款手机游戏

evidence_items.quote: There is a discrepancy in some items, that look "off". For instance, you have a very high detailed jacket, and at it's side there is a highly pixelated bag
evidence_items.description: 部分物品的视觉细节不一致，例如高细节夹克与像素化包袋并存
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些物品存在不一致，看起来“不对劲”。例如，你有一件细节非常高的夹克，而在它旁边有一个高度像素化的包

evidence_items.quote: the movement, inventory, and even the graphics are too rough and clunky for me
evidence_items.quote_zh: 移动、物品栏，甚至画面对我来说都太粗糙、太笨重了
